Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing ONE issue in the Email OS Vue/Tauri client (repo = your worktree). Read first: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md (focus/'you are here' signal rules — Dusk Lavender is the SINGLE "you are here" signal, details/disclosure notes), src/components/ReaderView.vue (message-details, onDetailsToggle, isDetailsOpen, the keyboard methods for N/P/O/Shift+O and details dismissal), src/App.vue keyboard dispatcher, src/assets/style.css (global :focus-visible, .message, .message-toggle, .message-details).

## Shared rules (all reader-review tasks)
- Context: we compared our conversation reader against a Superhuman screenshot. Superhuman has no per-message "Details" row and the active message shows just one signal (lavender bar on a raised card). Ours: a "▸ Details" row under EVERY message (3x in a 3-message thread), and the active message's toggle button also shows a 2px lavender focus ring on top of the 3px lavender bar (double signal).
- Stay on-brand per PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md: terse, honest-state, keyboard-first. Message content text-interpolated only. Keep keyboard-visible focus (PRODUCT.md accessibility: "visible focus remain required") — you may not simply delete focus indication; the active message bar IS the visible focus indicator for the message toggle, so remove the extra ring only on the message-toggle when the bar is showing, and make sure focus is still unmistakably visible (e.g. the bar + sender weight + fill) and that tabbing to other controls still shows the ring.
- Keep every existing `data-test` attribute and aria-label; update tests in tests/ and src that your change legitimately affects. Do NOT edit DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md — put design-doc notes in your final report.
- Other agents are changing the same files in parallel on separate branches (toolbar→header, collapsed snippets, body type/measure, star status line, active-card style, recent-mail filter). Keep your diff MINIMAL and localized; no reformatting.
- Setup: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (full suite; report honestly incl. pre-existing failures).
- Preview: `pnpm dev --port <PORT> --strictPort` (in-memory fixture workspace). Use mcp__t3-code__preview_* tools (load via ToolSearch), resize 1280x800, press Enter on the focused first row to open "Fixture thread 1: weekly status". Stop dev server and close preview tab when done.
- Evidence: save PNGs under the evidence dir below (mkdir -p). BEFORE (base commit) and AFTER at 1280x800 via preview_snapshot save=true (copy screenshotPath to named files). If blurry, retry and add getBoundingClientRect/computed-style measurements in the report.
- Commit on your worktree's branch (no push, no PR). End the commit message with: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Final report (brief): branch + head SHA, files changed, what you did, tests run/results, evidence absolute paths, DESIGN.md notes, anything you couldn't do.

## Your issue: P2 – Repeated and doubled chrome
1. Details: remove the always-visible "▸ Details" summary under every message. Keep the details content (From <addr>, To <addrs>, Sent <full date>) reachable: only inside the EXPANDED message, revealed by a quiet affordance in that message's header (e.g. clicking the "to Name" recipient text or a small chevron/"Details" text at the header's right, 12px icon-muted), and keep the existing keyboard path for details (see how App/Reader expose details toggle/dismiss; keep it working) — collapsed messages must show no Details UI at all. Preserve `message-details-<id>` / `message-details-summary-<id>` / participant test ids where the element still exists (adapt tests where the element is now only rendered when expanded).
2. Focus ring: on `.message-toggle:focus-visible` where the message is active (it carries the lavender bar), drop the extra 2px outline (use `outline: none` scoped to that case) but guarantee a non-colour focus cue remains (bold sender already exists). Check the global :focus-visible rule's specificity and don't regress other controls. Also double-check the reader container itself has no ring.
- Evidence dir: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p2-details-focus . PORT: 5204. Required: before/after at 1280x800 (all collapsed + expanded), after with Details open on the expanded message, after with keyboard focus on the active message (shows single signal), and one screenshot proving another control (e.g. a header/toolbar button) still shows its focus ring on Tab.

DESIGN.md:197:   - The Inbox coverage sentence is the tabs' accessible description and the tab strip's hover title. The browser-preview banner is a one-line amber "Preview · in-memory" note on the right; the full disclosure is its title and accessible text.
DESIGN.md:203:   - **Utilities:** Account (Gmail), Activity, Drafts and the narrow-viewport Contact disclosure are ghost glyphs at the bottom, 16px from the edge.
DESIGN.md:208:   Remaining: the badge counts only what the activity snapshot carries (the same rows Activity shows), not a separate mailbox-wide total. The Contact disclosure stays in the rail below 1000px; it has no Superhuman analogue.
DESIGN.md:210:4. **Focused row.** Done (rows pass): the fill is inset 6px from both pane edges, with a 4px Dusk Lavender bar on its own left edge.
DESIGN.md:213:7. **Row actions.** Done (rows pass): `icon-muted` inline SVG glyphs (`RowGlyph.vue`) replace the date on the focused or hovered row only. Accessible names, roving tab stops and the `meta-compact` disclosure stay. The disclosure now also re-measures on text-size changes inside an unchanged row box (rail/contact pass: the sender label is observed too). Remaining: Superhuman shows done/snooze/more; we show only our real actions (read/unread, done).
DESIGN.md:220:   - **Narrow disclosure:** inside the Contact disclosure below 1000px, the same content stacks compactly under the drawer header.
DESIGN.md:224:11. **Global button style.** Done (polish pass). The `button` defaults are zero-specificity (`:where()`), so every component class keeps its own look. The default is a ghost: transparent, Paper White, 4px radius, `4px 8px` (24px tall at 12px, the old chip's hit target), Lifted Charcoal on hover, Focus Stone on press, 0.45 opacity when disabled, and the 2px Dusk Lavender focus ring at a 1px offset. The selection bar, the action notice's Undo, Load more, the search form and the reader toolbar are ghost text buttons. Bordered `button-utility` chips (Lifted Charcoal, 1px Seam, `3px 8px`) appear only inside utility drawers, the modal attachment chooser, recovery banners (`.recovery-banner`: draft-close recovery, inbox/account load errors, the reader's navigation error, the header's saved-split error) and the synthetic workspace strip. Fields follow "Inputs / Fields": a Seam border that shifts to Dusk Lavender (plus a 1px inner outline) on keyboard focus, Smoke placeholders (4.76:1 on Lifted Charcoal) and a lavender ring on native checkboxes.
DESIGN.md:225:12. **Command overlay.** Done (polish pass; structure pass: groups, per-command glyphs, aliases, Keys list, "no match" copy, caption removed). The off-palette values the overlay still carried (#56534e border and rules, #c9c4bc caption, icon and hint text, #d4cfc7 disabled reasons, #66615b `kbd` fill, `.85rem` radius, the 46rem width, 24px query and 1.5rem glyph) are now tokens: a 576px Lifted Charcoal panel with a 10px radius, no border, Overlay lift over a `rgba(0,0,0,0.53)` backdrop at 15vh. The query is 16px on Deep Umber with a 1px Dusk Lavender border, items are 36px rows of 12px Body with 16px Graphite glyphs, the highlighted item is Focus Stone plus a 3px Dusk Lavender bar, disabled items are Smoke with Ash reasons, and `kbd` is Ash on Deep Umber. Geometry is whole-pixel so a highlighted item scrolled into view is never clipped. The modal attachment chooser shares the panel (46rem wide, 12px body), which closes the "chooser body inherits 16px" remainder of gap 14. (The violets this gap once listed were already gone before this pass.)
DESIGN.md:227:14. **Type scale and dates.** Done (2026-11-07 typeset pass). The shell type is semantic tokens on `:root`: `--type-headline` 1rem, `--type-body` 0.75rem, `--type-count` 0.6875rem, `--type-mono` 0.85rem, weights 400/600 only (`--weight-regular`, `--weight-strong`). `.app-main` sets Body as the shell default, so the rail, contact pane, notices, drawers, the reader chrome and form controls are 12px instead of an inherited 16px or ad hoc 0.8/0.85/0.9/0.95/1.1rem. Shell h2 is Headline; h3/h4 and in-panel drawer headings are Title; the reader subject is Headline at 600. Row dates follow the Label rules below and are deterministic (no default-locale dependence: the old `30 Sept 2001` vs `Sep 30, 2001` rendered-layout gate now passes under any `LANG`). Rows carry `<time datetime>` plus the full date as the title; reader message times are full dates with `datetime`. The rendered larger-text gate expected the compact action disclosure at a 25px root font (was 23px) after this pass, and at 34.5px (expanded at 30px) after the rail/contact pass, since the fixed-px rail and contact pane leave the list wider at every text size.
DESIGN.md:237:- **Dusk Lavender** (`focus-accent`): the single "you are here" signal. Used for the 4px bar on the focused row, the active message bar in the reader, focus outlines, and the highlighted command. It never fills an area and never decorates.
DESIGN.md:240:- **Orchid Dot** (`unread-marker`): only for the 5px unread dot in the row gutter. It is pinker than Dusk Lavender so that unread and focus never read as the same signal.
DESIGN.md:261:**The One Signal Rule.** Dusk Lavender appears at most once per screen, on the current row or message. If two violet things are visible, one of them is wrong.
DESIGN.md:305:- **Popover lift** (`box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)`): the compact row-actions disclosure panel.
DESIGN.md:317:- **Focused:** Focus Stone fill plus a 4px Dusk Lavender bar on the fill's own left edge. The date gives way to three action glyphs (done, snooze, more) at a 32px pitch.
DESIGN.md:341:- **Ghost (browsing shell, the default):** transparent, Paper White text or a Graphite glyph, 4px radius, `4px 8px` (24px tall). Text ghosts in the dock bars (selection actions, Undo, Load more) carry the Title weight. Hover lifts a text ghost to Lifted Charcoal and a glyph to Paper White; press is Focus Stone; disabled is 0.45 opacity. The focus ring is a 2px Dusk Lavender outline at a 1px offset.
DESIGN.md:346:- **Style:** a Lifted Charcoal panel, 10px radius, 576px max width, no border, Overlay lift, 15vh from the top. There is no caption: the placeholder and the dialog's accessible name say whether it is Commands or Destinations. The 38px query (16px Headline) sits on Deep Umber with a 1px Dusk Lavender border; it always owns keyboard focus, so that border is its focus indicator. Items are 36px rows of 12px Body with a 16px Graphite glyph that turns Paper White when highlighted. The highlighted item gets a Focus Stone fill plus a 3px Dusk Lavender left bar. Disabled items are Smoke, with their reason in Ash. Shortcuts are `kbd` in Ash on Deep Umber, compact ("G then E", timing in the tooltip). The hint line sits under a 1px Seam.
DESIGN.md:353:- **Focus:** the border shifts to Dusk Lavender, doubled by a 1px inner outline so the ring reads at 12px. No glow.
DESIGN.md:366:- **Do** use Dusk Lavender (#bba5ed) only for the current row or message, and the focus ring.
